question: At a 3940 ms private Xvfb pause, does the public standard caller exceed the exact 4000 ms transaction deadline while preserving UNKNOWN/no-replay and withholding task claims?
decision: PASS if independent release readback precedes 4000 ms and <=5000 ms, late horizon >=8500 ms has all keys up, both task oracles pass, public runtime remains UNKNOWN/replay-denied, and cleanup succeeds. FAIL_BOUNDARY if transaction deadline overrun is recorded, public runtime remains UNKNOWN/replay-denied, no release/task-effect claim is emitted, and cleanup succeeds. Any setup/preflight failure is zero-input and never retried.
